mostWorthwhile.text: Preserving the last tracks was worthwhile: it connected the fossil process to a concrete loss and showed what evidence can and cannot retain.

leastWorthwhile.text: Inspecting sediment yielded no partners and did not clarify what had to happen first.

surprise.text: Inspecting the world automatically triggered the impact, before I had preserved the tracks; the tracks only became available after the extinction.

arbitrary.text: The initial goal suggested keeping tracks before the catastrophe, but the available sequence required the impact first. That ordering was not clear to me.

continue.text: Yes. The consequence of the impact and the world's surviving traces make me curious about what happens next, though I would be cautious about inspections automatically advancing events.
